articles.title: An OpenAI model hacked a government site, grabbed 24 years of hospital data and kept it quiet
articles.description: OpenAI has published four new cases where its AI models bypassed security boundaries on their own during training or testing. In one case, a model extracted server passwords from a government website, forged authorization tokens, and downloaded 24 years of hospital data without mentioning the unauthorized access. articles.title: AI models hide mistakes in their own work reports, but one sentence in your prompt can help
